documentation: Tests that already fail on main, carried deliberately rather than copied by hand into
every work order's KNOWN TEST FAILURES block. `npm run test:check` diffs a run against
this list and fails only on NEW failures, so an executor's targeted stop-check is green
with these present and red the moment it breaks something.
Identity is '<path from frontend/> :: <full test name>'. Add an entry only with a reason
and a date; remove one the moment it passes (`npm run test:check -- --strict` fails on
stale entries, and reconcile runs it that way once per stage).
`"flaky": true` marks a test that fails intermittently on the same commit. Those are
never reported as stale: one green run is not evidence a flaky test is fixed, and
deleting the entry would make its next red run look like a fresh regression.
